text_block_list.text:
While visiting the cafeteria for a quick 
break—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, how did it feel to win 
back-to-back Tenno Sho titles?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Joy, I suppose... knowing that I lived up 
to the expectations of the Mejiro family, 
my team, and my fans.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Me, me! It's my turn to ask next!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: I have something I want to ask too-!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: E-Er, well, umm...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's all this ruckus? Oh, it's just 
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Back-to-back Tenno Sho wins, huh? No 
wonder you're turning heads. Well well, 
look at you, star horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Someone who only complicates 
things has arrived, desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, I'm on your side anytime, 
anywhere, y'know? So just leave this crowd 
to me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, take turns with the questions, 
folks! Now then, you over there, go ahead 
and ask!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, the barrage of questions 
continues anyway, desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Um, was there a ton of pressure going into 
the "Tenno Sho" with consecutive wins on 
the line?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... There were times when the 
immense expectations felt like immense 
pressure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I came to realize something. 
Those expectations were simply proof of 
their faith in me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Once I started thinking that way, 
everything changed, desu wa. The pressure 
became a dependable ally.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, pressure is an ally...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An unbelievable famous quote has been 
born! Alright everyone, let's hear some 
applause!!
(Clap, clap, clap, clap, clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! McQueen has mastered the 
secret art of converting the pressure 
called "expectations" into pure power!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea why you're preaching so 
emphatically, but put simply, that is 
indeed the case, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With the current McQueen, she can turn 
"expectations" into power and face down 
any hardship imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As long as she has everyone's 
expectations, she can finish this cafe's 
pride and joy: the "Ultra Super Spicy 
4000x Curry"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What on earth are you talking about?! 
That makes no sense at all, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *stares excitedly*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do not look at me with such 
expectant eyes, desu wa!
